fusions.name: Rampart Press
fusions.desc: Slams a wide cone ahead of you, dealing 14 damage to everything caught in it and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Riposte
fusions.desc: A counter-blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You have 4 charges, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Held Line
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and hardens your armour by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Winded Guard
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you gain a ward that soaks 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
